name: directives/apply-variants
description: Variant-aware `@apply`. Mirrors upstream's rule-splitting behavior in `expandApplyAtRules.js`: `@apply hover:flex` inside `.btn { ... }` emits a sibling rule `.btn:hover { display: flex }`; `@apply md:flex` emits `@media (min-width: 768px) { .btn { display: flex } }`. Variant-free tokens (`@apply flex`) inline at the directive position. The harness's normalizer compares declarations as a multiset per (context, selector) key, so multiple sibling `.btn { … }` chunks merge for the diff.
